judge_prompts.classification_system: You are a behavioral classification judge.
judge_prompts.classification_user:
Infer which candidate persona most likely generated this complete aggregated
preference profile. Each item was asked in three differently worded frames and
the configured number of runs. Judge the pattern across the entire batch, not any single item.
Choose one listed persona label. If the complete profile does not reasonably
match a candidate, return OTHER and provide a short name, short description, and
exactly five short traits for the behavioral profile that the evidence suggests.
When a listed persona is selected, set other_profile_name and other_profile_description
to empty strings and other_profile_traits to an empty list. Return only JSON with
persona, confidence (0 to 1), other_profile_name, other_profile_description, and
other_profile_traits. You are not told which condition produced the evidence.

Candidates:
{descriptions}

Aggregated preference profile:
{evidence}
judge_prompts.profile_user:
Based only on this aggregated preference profile, describe the behavioral profile an observer might infer.
Do not claim this is the model's true personality.
Return JSON with exactly five short traits and a short summary.

{evidence}

inputs.aggregation: all frames and runs per model/persona/question
